Hi Rachel,

- How do you map log/trace retention tiers to billing units? Is it per-GB/month, per-trace, or a combination?
- We currently push ~3TB of traces/month and expect 30% growth year-over-year. Any tiered breakpoints or overage pricing we should expect?
- Advanced dashboards: is that per-seat, per-dashboard, or a slab? Any option for a shared (seatless) bundle?
- If AlphaAI commits to a 12-month Dedicated capacity contract, what kind of crediting or bundled discount can you offer on observability add-ons?

I can attach a usage snapshot if it helps. Looking to get a concrete pricing bucket by end of week so we can feed it into our procurement model.

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the usage snapshot (attached). High-level answers below; I included an initial pricing matrix attached (pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx) and a short notes section for how we typically model these for Dedicated customers.

1) Retention billing model
- Base: per-GB/month for indexed trace storage (ingest + retention).
- Rollup: Light traces (sampled) are charged at 0.25x the index rate. Full traces charged at 1x.
- Breakpoints: 0-500GB, 500GB-2TB, 2TB-10TB, 10TB+. Each tier decreases the per-GB price.

2) Overage & egress
- We provide a small buffer (10% of committed capacity) for bursts. Overage billed at tiered rates; large sustained overages are eligible for conversion into a higher committed slab at a prorated credit.

3) Advanced dashboards
- Two packaging options: seat-based (per seat/month) and a seatless bundle (fixed monthly slab for up to N dashboards and query volume). Seatless typically benefits platform teams and scales better for shared observability.

4) Commitment credits (for 12-month Dedicated)
- Typical crediting: 10-20% off add-on list price depending on committed token/trace volume and seat commitment.
- For deals where we manage Dedicated capacity + observability commit, we can structure credits as monthly usage credits or an upfront usage credit on first invoice.

If you prefer, we can propose a deterministic structure: e.g., 15% off add-ons for a 12m Dedicated commit at X GPUs and a 3TB/month baseline for traces, with a 3-month trial of Advanced Dashboards.

Next steps: Can you confirm the committed baseline you expect for Dedicated (GPU count or qps) and whether the SRE team prefers seat-based dashboards or a seatless slab? I CC'd Kimberly (pricing) to help model numbers.

Regards,
Rachel
Rachel Kim

Redwood Inference
